reasons.plausibility: Stress-induced segregation and precipitation in HEAs is scientifically plausible, though not conclusively established and may depend strongly on temperature and alloy specifics.
reasons.testability: The proposed controlled mechanical tests with microstructural analyses provide a clear way to detect or rule out stress-induced precipitates and their effect on toughness.
reasons.usefulness: It gives a focused mechanism and a straightforward experimental route to determine whether localized precipitation drives embrittlement under service conditions.
